from PyQt5 import QtWidgets, uic


def verif(ch):
    ok = 2 <= len(ch) <= 12
    i = -1
    while ok and i < len(ch) - 1:
        i += 1
        ok = "A" <= ch[i] <= "Z"
    return ok


def Afficher(ch):
    if verif(ch):
        if zigzag(ch):
            win.t2.setText("Nom zigazag")
        else:
            win.t2.setText("Nom non-zigazag")
    else:
        win.t2.setText("INPUT ERROR")


def zigzag(ch):
    i = -1
    c = 1
    ok = True
    test_croissance = ch[0] < ch[1]
    if test_croissance:
        while ok and i < len(ch) - 2:
            i += 1
            a = ord(ch[i]) * c
            b = ord(ch[i + 1]) * c
            ok = a < b
            c *= -1
    elif not (test_croissance):
        while ok and i < len(ch) - 2:
            i += 1
            a = ord(ch[i]) * c
            b = ord(ch[i + 1]) * c
            ok = a > b
            c *= -1
    else:
        ok = False
    return ok


def effacer():
    win.t1.setText('')
    win.t2.setText('')
    win.t1.setFocus()


def fermer():
    win.close()


#####################PP##########################
app = QtWidgets.QApplication([])
win = uic.loadUi("epreuve_bac_pratique_2015_sujet9_interface.ui")
win.show()
win.pb1.clicked.connect(lambda: Afficher(win.t1.text()))
win.pb2.clicked.connect(effacer)
win.pb3.clicked.connect(fermer)
app.exec_()
